page.overview:
Who is Bennic Halloren?

Bennic Halloren was a human male intelligence officer and spy who served in Republic Intelligence, the Imperial Security Bureau, and eventually the mercenary and independent covert group Zero Company. During the Clone Wars, Bennic recruited and assisted Zero Company on behalf of the Galactic Republic, overseeing operations alongside dispossessed noblewoman Jae Mordant to investigate the Infinite Coil, a paramilitary cult aligned with the Confederacy of Independent Systems who sought to infest the galaxy with the Shadow Plague. Bennic served as advisor to the Zero Company's leader Hawks in the group's base of operations, the Den on the Ring of Kafrene.

After Republic Intelligence received reports of a Separatist Fleet massing in the Serolonis system Bennic and Jae planned a mission to retrieve a holopuck from Serolonis with ties to the Separatist paramilitary group known as the Infinite Coil. For this mission Jae suggested they hire Tesh Hawks the former captain of the 100th clone company who, after the Battle of Antine, was discharged and had since formed their own independent intelligence outfit known as Zero Company. Although Bennic had his doubts about Jae's suggestion she convinced him that since their window was closing they had to take the risk or lose, to which Bennic relented and cleared the funds to hire Zero Company for the job.

After Zero Company successfully completed the mission, Bennic and Jae travelled to the Ring of Kafrene to deliver payment for the job and personally meet with Hawks to recruit them in order to retake Luunata and help take down the Infinite Coil and their leader Kundri Fathom. Although Hawks initially refused the contract, Bennic convinced them by revealing his knowledge that Zero Company was indebted to the Hutts and offering them a way out of the debt via the contract. After doubling the payment per Hawk's request Zero Company accepted the contract and Bennic and Jae were embedded within their outfit, with Bennic setting up a station within The Den's command center.
